title: About to act on a wrong claim
about: Barge-in from partial transcripts: naming a resource with an open, confirmed wrong claim is not enough; an instruction to act on it now is.

lines.speaker: Jordan
lines.text: The payments API is erroring too, I bet that's what's breaking checkout.
lines.why: false claim; no gap to raise it

lines.speaker: Mei
lines.text: Hmm, the payments API dashboards look quiet to me.
lines.why: nobody corrected Jordan, so the agent takes a second look; Mei names the resource but tells nobody to act: no barge

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Okay. Jordan, restart the payments API now, and Lee, keep an eye on the dashboards.
lines.why: the agent confirmed the claim is wrong; cut Priya off before the restart goes ahead

lines.speaker: Priya
lines.text: Good catch. Jordan, hold off on that.
